title: Receipt total is one cent short
issue:
Receipt total is one cent short for some carts

We print receipts with tillroll at our café. For this cart the subtotal is a cent lower than the till:

```json
[
  { "sku": "LAT", "name": "Oat latte", "price": 4.35, "qty": 1 },
  { "sku": "MUF", "name": "Blueberry muffin", "price": 2.95, "qty": 2 }
]
```

```
$ bun run src/cli.ts cart.json
1 x Oat latte  $4.34
2 x Blueberry muffin  $5.90
Subtotal: $10.24
Tax: $0.82
Total: $11.06
```

4.35 + 2 × 2.95 is 10.25. It only happens with some prices; carts with $2.50 or $3.00 items are always right. The tests pass, so I'm not sure where to look.
